verdict.rationale: Rainforest has a dedicated OpenAPI reference page stating that it provides OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) 3.1.0 of the Rainforest API, which delivers the core of the story. The probe got 404s only on guessed conventional paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.). That shows the spec is not at those URLs; it does not contradict the documented spec. Missing for 10: a confirmed direct download URL or file, hands-on verification that the spec downloads and parses, and details on coverage or versioning of the spec.
